Ubisoft to sunset Rainbow 6 Mobile just seven months after launch
Mobile

Ubisoft to sunset Rainbow Six Mobile just seven months after launch
The tactical mobile shooter was only globally released earlier this year.
Imran Khan
,
Contributor
October 9, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
Image via Ubisoft
Newsbrief
: Ubisoft has announced that
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile
is ending development, with the game itself shutting down on January 15, 2027.
The final season will still be released next week as planned.
Rainbow Six Mobile
was a free-to-play spinoff of the popular tactical shooter series and was rolled out globally earlier this year in February.
You can read
the entire announcement on the game's website
.
